summary: Applied 13 of 15 planned items across bugs, refactors, and UI/UX: selection-version guard in SessionCapability.newSession, in-flight promise return in WebSocketTransport.connect, project-watch-coordinator re-pointing stale watches, extension-host error logging, parsers.ts collapsed to 21 one-line parser<T>(schema) calls, shared requireService on ProjectServiceRegistry, UnsavedChangesGuard + DiscardChangesDialog replacing native confirm() calls, and several small UI tweaks (confirm dialogs, clipboard danger toast, attachment-limit tooltip, inline question send-error, shared sidebar-empty block). Skipped extension.ui early return (false positive), AgentStore facade split, MessageList effect merge, and FakeAgentClient argument dropping.
decisions: Bug 1 fix: SessionCapability.newSession bumps and checks #selectionVersion so a stale failure cannot revert a newer session.
Bug 2 fix: WebSocketTransport.connect stores and returns the in-flight #opening promise instead of throwing on a concurrent call.

Bug 3 fix: rather than adding unsubscribe to on-disk ProjectService.watchStatus, the coordinator now tracks per-service watches per path and re-points every previously-watched service when the project path changes.
Bug 4: extension poll failures now log workspace path and error instead of a silent catch.
Skipped Bug 5 (extension.ui.* early return) — those events are consumed by a separate subscriber, so buffering would duplicate work.
Skipped AgentStore facade split and MessageList effect merge — both touch every caller or scroll behavior with small payoff.
Skipped FakeAgentClient argument dropping — fake methods are intentional no-ops and the interface already enforces the real signature.
parsers.ts refactor: collapsed 21 copied parseX functions into 21 one-line parser<T>(schema) calls.
requireService hoisted to a method on ProjectServiceRegistry so it is defined once.

Native confirm() dialogs (7 callsites) replaced by a new UnsavedChangesGuard class plus DiscardChangesDialog.svelte; the guard is constructed in App.svelte and passed down as a prop, replacing the previous dirty bindable chain.
Discard confirmations use the styled ConfirmDialog rather than native confirm.
Sidebar empty states (workspace threads empty, sidebar empty) consolidated onto a shared sidebar-empty block with a hint line.
Did not touch the 4 files that already exceeded the 300-line check:loc limit — they were over before this session.
errors: Coordinator test 'rejects for an unknown extension' initially failed because the coordinator throws synchronously for an unknown extension; test was adjusted to expect the thrown error rather than a rejection, then all 324 tests passed.
Prettier --check reported style issues in 5 touched files; resolved by running prettier --write on those files.
apps/agent-server/test run initially failed (1 of 27 files) for the same unknown-extension reason before the test fix.
